descriptionChirho: A distant place or remoteness, used both as an abstract noun ('distance, far-off places') and concretely ('distant lands'). Most frequently in the prepositional phrase מִמֶּרְחָק 'from afar' (Ps 138:6; Prov 31:14; Isa 10:3; 17:13; 30:27; Jer 5:15; 31:10; Ezek 23:40). Also used independently for remote regions or expanses (Prov 25:25; Isa 8:9; 13:5; 33:17; 46:11; Jer 4:16; 6:20; 8:19; Zech 10:9). The plural מֶרְחַקִּים intensifies the sense of vastness or multiple far-flung places.
